text: How does the paper turn countless particle spins into one cosmic number? That averaging step is cited, not derived. It squares the total density of six neutrino types, as if their spins line up. Treating the species independently makes the torsion estimate exactly six times smaller. The printed value sits near the lined-up edge, so we carry both. A journal correction notice exists, but its content remains unread behind a paywall. We quarantined the affected printed numbers and recomputed them. The spring-like picture survives as a proposal. Its exact strength is not unique.
